app: llm.c (karpathy/llm.c), train_gpt2.cu, upstream commit f1e2ace + the CUDA-13 cudaMemAdvise patch in this directory
topology: du04: 1 node x 4 A100-SXM4-40GB, 4 ranks, NCCL over NVLink. No InfiniBand, no UCX, no NVBit.
golden: none — a third-party application is not a regression gate (see apps/README.md)
why: Round 1 judged this workload against the raw NCCL tables only. Round 2 adds the `kernel` provider — which no case in tests/hpc/cases/ asserts anything about — and the derived layer that `comshu link` builds, so that the capture can be asked what the GPU actually ran and not only what the application asked for.
workload_note:
Identical parameter names and values to meta.json's block, with ranks=4/nodes=1 for du04. Command line: `-e d6 -b 2 -t 1024 -x 4 -v 1000 -m 1 -s 0 -h 0 -d 8192` plus `-z 0` or `-z 1`. Every number is read out of llm.c's source; see PREDICTION-r2.md for the derivation, which was committed before the first r2 capture existed.

The round-2 assertions need two quantities that PARAM_COLS has no column for — the NCCL device-kernel launch count and the number of ncclGroupStart/End pairs per step at ZeRO-1 (23, being groups_per_iter + NUM_PARAMETER_TENSORS). Both are therefore derived inside the SQL from quantities the capture already holds (nccl_group row count, float32 collective count) rather than added as parameters. That the closed parameter list forced this is recorded in QUESTIONS.md, not worked around silently.

expect_fail_asserts.rank_identity_names_the_device_r2: rank_identity.device is NULL and label reads 'n0 · GPU ?' on every capture in this study, while nccl_comm.cuda_dev and gpu_kernel.device both name 0..3 in the same export. link_health reports nothing about it. See REPORT-r2.md §3.

not_covered: comm_edges, transport_mix, endpoint, object_access, tag_flow and tag_recv_resolved are all empty, and for this workload that is correct rather than a gap in the run: llm.c makes no point-to-point call, so nothing names a peer; there is no UCX and no ibverbs to mix transports over; and no gpumem pass was taken, so there are no GPU accesses to place in objects. asserts/collective_only_means_no_invented_edges_r2.sql states the comm_edges half as a claim rather than leaving it an absence.
cost_note: Seconds. Four captures plus a bare run is under two minutes on du04. The kernel provider is CUPTI activity: 1251 kernels per rank at -z 0, dropped=0, and it costs ~2% of step time (8.72 ms bare -> 8.91 ms captured). Nothing here uses NVBit.
